sources.title: opcode README.md
sources.locator: Features; installation; Security; usage alerts coming soon
sources.finding: Documents Claude Code desktop GUI, Windows/macOS/Linux source build, custom agents, checkpoints and coming-soon alerts. Security section claims no telemetry and configurable per-agent file/network restrictions; actual implementation conflicts.

sources.title: opcode LICENSE
sources.finding: Repository license is AGPL-3.0; separate Claude Code and model services are not relicensed.

sources.title: opcode src-tauri/Cargo.toml
sources.finding: Rust Tauri2 desktop with React frontend and optional Axum opcode-web binary; source version0.2.1 differs from latest published release0.2.0.

sources.title: opcode src-tauri/src/commands/agents.rs
sources.locator: Agent/AgentRun; init_database; CRUD; execute_agent; spawn_agent_system; export_agent/import_agent
sources.finding: SQLite agents and run records retain system prompts, tasks, model, project, session IDs and timestamps. Execution starts independent installed Claude processes using --dangerously-skip-permissions, without applying enable_file_read/write/network flags. First-output timeout30s tries Unix kill. After stdout/stderr close the monitor marks completed and emits success without checking child exit status. JSON agents can be imported/exported.

sources.title: opcode src-tauri/src/commands/claude.rs
sources.finding: Desktop chat uses Claude --resume/--continue and stream-json with skipped permissions. A new chat launch takes and kills the previous global current_process; background agent runs use a different registry. Local JSONL is reloadable; native task planning/tracker state is not added. CLAUDE.md and Claude settings are editable files.

sources.title: opcode src-tauri/src/process/registry.rs
sources.finding: In-memory per-run process registry tracks PID, role/model/task and output with kill controls; not a persistent worker supervisor, quota queue or OS security boundary.

sources.title: opcode src-tauri/src/web_server.rs
sources.finding: Optional source web server binds0.0.0.0:8080 with permissive CORS and no authentication. REST agents/usage/MCP and several actions are stubs, but /ws/claude actually starts Claude commands. Websocket disconnect removes routing channel, not a managed durable run/reconnect protocol.

sources.title: opcode src-tauri/src/web_main.rs
sources.finding: opcode-web exposes port/host launch flags; host is parsed but not passed to server, which hardcodes all interfaces. This is a server launcher, not a task-management CLI.

sources.title: opcode src-tauri/src/commands/mcp.rs
sources.finding: Desktop delegates stdio/SSE server configuration and local/project/user scope to Claude mcp CLI, passes environment entries and imports Claude Desktop settings. mcp_serve starts Claude itself, not an opcode management MCP server. Connection test only calls claude mcp get.

sources.title: opcode src-tauri/src/commands/usage.rs
sources.finding: Reads local Claude JSONL, prefers costUSD then estimates only Opus4/Sonnet4 families using static prices; other models return zero. Aggregates tokens/cost by model/day/project/session, with no billing reconciliation or spend enforcement.

sources.title: opcode src/components/UsageDashboard.tsx
sources.finding: Dashboard loads/caches date-filtered aggregates and drilldowns; no CSV/JSON export action or spend alert implementation found in the complete component.

sources.title: opcode src-tauri/src/checkpoint/manager.rs
sources.finding: Tracks selected file tools and heuristic shell modifications; snapshots modified text files and messages. Restore deletes current non-hidden files absent from snapshot set, then writes captured files and resets messages. This is a bounded, potentially destructive file/transcript rewind, not process memory or complete environment rollback.

sources.title: opcode src-tauri/src/checkpoint/storage.rs
sources.finding: Local checkpoint metadata, JSONL and compressed content-addressed file snapshots persist. Explicit keep-count cleanup removes oldest checkpoint data and unreferenced content; no remote or timed retention commitment.

sources.title: opcode src/components/ClaudeCodeSession.tsx
sources.locator: queuedPrompts; completion listeners; TimelineNavigator; handleFork; cancel
sources.finding: Chat supports prompt queue, stopping, continuing, timeline/fork and local transcript rendering. Queue is React state, not durable dispatch. Source includes responsive sm layouts; no empirical usability result.

sources.title: opcode src/lib/analytics/consent.ts
sources.finding: Fresh and error-fallback settings default enabled:true,hasConsented:true; stored false is respected. Revocation persists locally. deleteAllData resets ID and defaults to enabled again, not server deletion.

sources.title: opcode src/lib/analytics/index.ts
sources.finding: PostHog us.i.posthog.com receives pseudonymous IDs, screen/usage/error events. Autocapture and session recording disabled; regex sanitization is not proof of anonymity. disable opts out capturing; no server retention/deletion API is implemented.

sources.title: opcode src/lib/analytics/events.ts
sources.finding: Event vocabulary includes prompts submitted, tool execution, agent progress, errors and resource/performance metadata; event names do not prove full prompt text upload.

sources.title: opcode src/main.tsx
sources.finding: Analytics initialization runs at frontend startup.

sources.title: opcode src/components/Settings.tsx
sources.locator: Analytics toggle676; permission rules782; cleanup setting640
sources.finding: In-app persisted analytics switch calls analytics.enable/disable. UI also claims no file contents and that unset allow rules ask permission, while execution uses skip-permissions; settings form alone is not enforcement. cleanupPeriodDays is a Claude setting, not proof opcode deletes all copies.

sources.title: opcode src-tauri/src/commands/storage.rs
sources.finding: Local database inspector can query/edit/delete rows; retained local audit-like data is mutable, not append-only authenticated history.
